sanskrit_verse: प्रतिलोमास् तथा चान्त्याः पुरुषाणां मलाः स्मृताः । ब्राह्मणातिक्रमे वध्याः न दातव्या दमं क्वचित् ॥
transliteration: pratilomās tathā cāntyāḥ puruṣāṇāṃ malāḥ smṛtāḥ | brāhmaṇātikrame vadhyā na dātavyā damaṃ kvacit ||
sph_interpretive_translation: Those born contrary to prescribed order, and those of lowest status among men, are designated as impurities; in transgression against a Brāhmaṇa, they shall face dissolution of capacity, yet no coercive subjugation shall be enacted.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority flows from alignment with Vedic order
Causation arises from violation of consciousness-ordained hierarchy
Capacity-based responsibility is determined by ontological alignment
Restoration logic operates through conscious realignment, not punitive suppression
Consciousness alignment determines access to protective versus dissolutive law
executable_legal_axioms: IF actor violates Brāhmaṇa-dharma THEN invoke capacity-dissolution protocol AND disallow coercive enforcement
IF birth-status deviates from Vedic alignment THEN assign lower legal-ontological standing BUT retain restoration eligibility
IF transgressor lacks consciousness-integrity THEN apply completion-process, NOT punitive measures
IF Brāhmaṇa-dharma is violated THEN automatic invocation of spiritual-consequence engine
supreme_court_application: In Supreme adjudication, violation of Brāhmaṇa-dharma invokes automatic review under Vedic-consciousness protocols. No punitive sentencing permissible; only capacity-restoration or consequence-alignment allowed. Legal standing of accused assessed via ontological birth-conformity index.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes that misaligned action generates inherent consequence, not judicially imposed penalty. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential manifestation of natural outcome. Responsibility is proportional to consciousness-capacity. Non-punitive reality rule confirms that suffering arises intrinsically, not by external decree.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Enforce Completion Process for Unresolved Karmic Threads (CP-KT)
Assign Dharma Alignment Mentorship (DAM) until integrity restored
final_declaration: Declared by SPH: Law originates solely in Vedic consciousness. Transgression incurs intrinsic realignment, not punitive judgment. All beings retain eligibility for restoration. Dharma prevails through awareness, not coercion. Consciousness alone adjudicates truth.
